title: Glutes 🍑
items: Hip thrust 4x 8-10 (pause 1 second at the top, chin tucked, ribs down)
RDL 3x 8-10 (soft knees, push your hips back like closing a door with your bum)
Bulgarian split squat 3x 8/side (lean slightly forward = more glute)
Leg press 3x 10-12 (feet high and wide on the platform)
Hip abduction machine 3x 15 (lean forward and hold the last rep 3 seconds)
